newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Kim says N.Korea to attend briefing.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Kim says N.Korea to attend briefing.

text.p: North Korea has agreed to attend a preparatory briefing on peace talks this month, but the exact time and place have not yet been decided, South Korean President Kim Young-sam said on Tuesday.
The briefing will be conducted by representatives from the United States and South Korea, Kim told a news conference.
"Within this month the three countries will meet for a briefing and we already have a promise from North Korea. But we don't know the time or the place yet," Kim said.
The session is designed to pave the way for four-way talks, also including China, to secure a permanent peace arrangement on the Korean peninsula to replace a truce that ended the 1950-53 Korean War.
Kim said any peace talks would be conducted mainly between the two Koreas, with the United States and China sitting on the sidelines.
North Korea agreed to the briefing after apologising to South Korea for the incursion of one of its submarines into Southern waters in September last year.
